title: Sheep reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sheep body: fluffy wool cloud -->
  <g fill='#f4f1e8'>
    <circle cx='36' cy='56' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='52' r='14'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='57' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='64' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='65' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='63' r='10'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='64' r='10'/>
  </g>
  <!-- wool shading for edges -->
  <g fill='#d9d3c4'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='67' r='8'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='68' r='8'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='9'/>
  </g>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='14' fill='#c9b8a6'/>
  <!-- fluffy top of head -->
  <g fill='#f4f1e8'>
    <circle cx='42' cy='26' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='23' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='26' r='6'/>
  </g>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='34' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#b09b86'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='34' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#b09b86'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='36' r='2.6' fill='#3a2f28'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='36' r='2.6' fill='#3a2f28'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='35.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='35.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose/snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#a8927c'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='72' width='5' height='13' rx='2.5' fill='#8a7663'/>
  <rect x='57' y='72' width='5' height='13' rx='2.5' fill='#8a7663'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='37.5' y='82' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a4038'/>
  <rect x='56.5' y='82' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a4038'/>

  <!-- book -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 50 78)'>
    <rect x='34' y='72' width='32' height='20' rx='2' fill='#c0392b'/>
    <rect x='34' y='72' width='32' height='20' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#e8746a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <!-- pages -->
    <rect x='36' y='74' width='28' height='16' rx='1' fill='#fff6e0'/>
    <!-- spine line -->
    <line x1='50' y1='74' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='#c9a977' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <!-- text lines -->
    <g stroke='#b48a5a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'>
      <line x1='38' y1='78' x2='48' y2='78'/>
      <line x1='38' y1='81' x2='48' y2='81'/>
      <line x1='38' y1='84' x2='48' y2='84'/>
      <line x1='52' y1='78' x2='62' y2='78'/>
      <line x1='52' y1='81' x2='62' y2='81'/>
      <line x1='52' y1='84' x2='62' y2='84'/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- front hoof holding book -->
  <rect x='40' y='68' width='5' height='6' rx='2' fill='#8a7663'/>
  <rect x='57' y='68' width='5' height='6' rx='2' fill='#8a7663'/>
</svg>
